summary: Iteration 3 (additive features) — ALL GREEN. Backend: 7/7 new pytest cases pass against live https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host (GET /api/reports/spend returns full shape {total_annual_spend, by_utility, by_site, contracts} with 0 spend for test account; POST /api/quotes/request returns {quote_request_id} for both electricity and gas; GET /api/support/resources returns {resources:[...]} with 4 articles; GET /api/properties/{bogus}/utilities returns a graceful 4xx). Auth-gating verified on all three (401/403 without token). Previous suite (iteration_2 test_uch_api.py, 9 tests) is untouched and still passing. Frontend (Expo web preview @ 390x844): (1) Get A Quote — /quote/new renders quote-header + horizontal chip row (electricity/gas/water/telecoms all present); tapping gas turns the chip orange (verified computed backgroundColor rgb(242,80,40)); optional quote-message accepts text; quote-submit POSTs to /api/quotes/request and navigates to /quote/success/{uuid} with quote-success-title visible (real quote created, id 814caab8-b383-42ac-a296-2be24e8eb195). (2) Spend Reports — /reports shows reports-header, reports-empty and reports-scan-button for the shared no-spend account; profile-reports-link on Profile tab navigates to /reports. (3) Help Centre — support-tab-chat and support-tab-help segments both render; tapping Help centre lists 4 help-resource-<i> cards from GET /api/support/resources; tapping help-resource-0 opens the detail modal with help-detail-body (389 chars of rendered content); Chat still works (support-input + support-send present). (4) Site Details — Sites tab still shows sites-empty for zero-property account; navigating to /sites/fake-bogus-id renders site-detail-header and, after the API returns an error for the bogus id, shows site-detail-error gracefully (no red screen, no crash). (5) Regression — signout from profile-signout-button lands on /signin. Every one of the 28 /api/... requests captured during the run went to the FULL external base https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host (single-host verified).

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking web console warning: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' Same finding as iteration_2 — unchanged. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme/theme.ts (shadow.card used by sites FAB and dashboard scan tile).

action_items: None required for iteration 3 — all 4 new features and the regression pass end-to-end against the live backend.
Optional cleanup (carried over from iteration_2): migrate shadow.card in /app/frontend/src/theme/theme.ts to boxShadow (or Platform-gate) to silence RN web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: quote/new.tsx cleanly maps to legacy POST /api/quotes/request with {utility_type, message, contract_id|null, property_id|null}, then router.replace to /quote/success/:id — no navigation stack pollution on repeat.
reports.tsx correctly derives isEmpty from (total===0 && by_utility.length===0) and renders reports-empty with a Scan-a-bill CTA — matches the no-spend fixture returned by the live backend.

sites/[id].tsx normalizes multiple possible response shapes (contracts | utilities | array; meter_reads | meters | reads) and gracefully falls back to site-detail-error on API failure — verified with bogus id (no crash, no red screen).

support.tsx segmented control cleanly toggles chat/help. GET /api/support/resources is fired once from a mount-only useEffect (not on tab-switch), which is efficient. Detail modal renders lightweight markdown (## / # / bullets) safely.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 real quote requests on the shared test account via POST /api/quotes/request (electricity + gas, both with 'TEST_from_pytest'/'TEST_playwright' messages). One additional playwright-driven quote was created (id 814caab8-b383-42ac-a296-2be24e8eb195). Non-destructive; the test account was NOT deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features (Get A Quote, Spend Reports, Help Centre, Site Details) are live and working against https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host. Test account has no contracts/sites by design, so the Renewals card-level 'Get a better deal' (renewals-quote-<i>) and Site Detail 'Get a quote' (site-quote-<i>) entry buttons cannot be exercised — the /quote/new screen was verified directly (which is what the review request instructed). If you need to test those entry buttons, seed a property+contract on the backend first. The shadow* deprecation warning is the only known cosmetic issue.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs surfaced during this iteration.
